title: First Day at the Factory
mainIdea: Hard work can be challenging, but perseverance and responsibility help people provide a better future for their families.

pages.text: Stanley Marks began his first day working at Ford's factory.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: Stanley wanted to do well at his new job so he could help support his family.

options: To succeed at his job and support his family

pages.text: The factory work was fast, repetitive, and tiring, making the job difficult.

options: The work was difficult and exhausting.
He forgot where the factory was.

pages.text: Stanley learned his task, followed the instructions, and worked hard throughout the day.

question.text: How did Stanley respond to the challenge?
options: He learned his job and worked hard.

pages.text: Although the work was difficult, Stanley stayed because the pay could help his family live a better life.

options: Stanley continued working to provide for his family.
Stanley became the owner of Ford.

elements.correct: To do well at his job and support his family
distractors: To quit the factory on his first day
To become the manager of the factory

elements.correct: The work was hard, repetitive, and tiring
distractors: The factory had no work for him
The other workers refused to help him

elements.correct: He learned his task and worked hard all day
distractors: He refused to work on the assembly line
He left the factory during his training

elements.correct: He stayed for his family's better future
distractors: He quit the job before the day ended
He became the owner of the factory
